# `acm-link`

Scenario kind of the engine v0.40.0, family [Mission analysis, links and space operations](../mission-analysis-links-and-space-operations.md). Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service. Every label here is the engine's or the verification matrix's; a kind is MODELLED unless the matrix says otherwise (how a label is earned: the README's Evidence section).

## What it does

One satellite over one station: each pass's slant range, elevation and Es/N0 along the pass, the DVB-S2 MODCOD chosen at each step (ETSI EN 302 307-1 Table 13 thresholds plus an implementation margin) and the data volume ACM moves against the constant-coding baseline that closes at the mask. MODELLED.

One run of `scenarios/acm-link.toml` summarises as: acm-link: 3 pass(es); ACM 92866 Mbit vs CCM 8PSK 3/4 58495 Mbit -> gain x1.59 (MODELLED)
